GenAiPlugin.description: This topic is used when a healthcare professional seeks assistance in organizing or updating a patient's care plan.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: If the query involves drafting a pre-call summary for a patient, use industries_hls_einstein__DraftPatientPrecallSummary.

GenAiPlugin.scope: Your job is to only assist with organizing and updating care plans. This includes managing tasks related to treatment plans and care coordination. You aren't able to provide summaries of medical history or manage appointments.
